newsitem.title: USA: COHR sees Q4 revenues below estimates.
newsitem.headline: COHR sees Q4 revenues below estimates.

text.p: COHR Inc said late Tuesday it expects revenues in its fourth quarter to be below analysts' estimates.

The company said in a statement that it expects revenues of between $25.4 and $25.8 million for its fourth quarter, which it will report on May 29th. Analysts had forecast revenues of about $27 million. The company had revenues of $18.75 million in the comparable year-ago period.

COHR said the difference between its projected revenues and analysts' estimates was due to a delay in the closing of its recent Stryker/Mediquip acquisition to February from January, which delayed the booking of revenue for one month. The lower revenues were also caused by the delayed sale of a single large piece of medical equipment and a slower than expected ramp-up in one maintenance contract.
